questions.question_text: Up to what grade level of coursework does the ACT Math Test measure skills?
questions.explanation: The test measures mathematical skills typically acquired in courses up to the beginning of grade 12.

questions.question_text: How many questions are in the Math Test section?
questions.explanation: The Math Test consists of 45 questions to be completed in 50 minutes.

options: Up to the beginning of grade 10
Up to the beginning of grade 12
Up to the beginning of grade 9

questions.question_text: Can a calculator be used during the Math Test?
options: Yes, but only a basic model.
Yes, permitted calculators are allowed for this test.
Only for students with specific accommodations.
questions.explanation: The ACT allows the use of permitted calculators specifically for the math portion of the exam.

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of the Math Test?
options: To test your ability to read scientific reports.
To measure mathematical skills acquired in school.
To evaluate your knowledge of computer programming.
To assess your ability to write persuasive essays.
questions.explanation: The math test is designed to measure the mathematical skills you have typically acquired through your high school curriculum.
